messages:
samir: hitting a flurry of SG creation 429s when onboarding new cloud accounts in us-west2. GPU fleet launches are stuck.
alex: can you paste the error text from the cloud API? is this a per-account request-rate limit or a global security-group quota?
maria: likely request-rate throttling, we've seen the provider throttle 'CreateSecurityGroup' during bursts. backoff + jitter helps but onboarding is a batch job so still bad.
samir: here are the logs from the provisioning job:\n```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z ERROR cloud-api "CreateSecurityGroup" 429 ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded for CreateSecurityGroup
service request id: abc-123
stack: infra/provisioner:attempt=3
```
samir: we ramped 200 accounts in parallel to create per-account SGs for subnet isolation.
jen: that explains it. two options: 1) file a support case with provider asking to raise request-rate, 2) change the onboarding to pre-create reusable SG templates (single SG per region) and then attach rules per-account to avoid the CreateSecurityGroup spike.
alex: for (1) we'll need account ids and example request ids. @samir can you open the provider ticket and include the log snippet and approximate qps when it hit?
samir: opened ticket INC-2026-334 and included logs + provisioning job timestamps. ops-bot: created incident INC-2026-334 and linked runbook https://redwood.runbooks/sg-throttle (automated)
ops-bot: suggested temp mitigation: sequentialize creation, target parallelism <= 8 for us-west2 until provider confirms increase.
maria: also consider caching SG IDs in the onboarding state so retries reuse existing SGs instead of creating duplicates.
claire: how bad is the customer impact/cost? are we failing embeds/gpu jobs or just delaying them?
samir: blocked GPU node provisioning in ~18% of onboarding attempts. some customers hit queueing and a few timed out and retried which added cloud bill due to excess API retries.
jen: can we throttle the orchestrator and add exponential backoff with 50ms base + jitter? that'll drastically reduce 429s immediately.
alex: I can add a feature flag to the orchestrator to reduce parallel SG creates per-region and enable caching. low-risk deploy.
samir: deploying feature flag now to dev, will roll to prod in 10m if smoke looks good.
claire: please keep ticket updated and ask provider for permanent per-account rate bump. also request quota review for number of SGs per VPC in us-west2 in case we hit limits later.
maria: noted — I'll draft the provider support text and include sample timestamps, api request ids, and job QPS numbers.
samir: thanks all :thumbsup: we'll follow up after provider responds or once the feature-flag roll completes.
